chunks.title: Zurich Life & Pension Türkiye (Zurich Group) (Zurich Türkiye) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Zurich Life & Pension Türkiye (Zurich Group) is a Institutional / Catalytic / Climate PE headquartered in Türkiye (Switzerland Parent). At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: COP31 Business Forum Climate Finance & Investments Working Group member (Insurance & Resilience Finance). Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Climate resilience risk-transfer, parametric insurance & ESG pension fund impact investing in Türkiye. Source verification: https://www.copbusiness.org/papers/COP31_WG_climate-finance-investments.pdf.

chunks.title: Zurich Türkiye Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Zurich Life & Pension Türkiye (Zurich Group) provides the following climate financing instruments: Climate Resilience Insurance, ESG Institutional Allocation, Impact Bond Allocation. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 1,000,000 to USD 50,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Municipality, Large Corporate, Project SPV, Fund Manager.

chunks.title: Zurich Türkiye Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Zurich Life & Pension Türkiye (Zurich Group): Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Resilient Cities & Infrastructure, Sustainable Agriculture & Water. Target geographic focus includes: Türkiye, Europe, Global. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Zurich Türkiye Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Zurich Türkiye's application form: Quantifiable climate risk reduction or resilience impact; Institutional-grade governance & impact reporting; Alignment with Zurich Net-Zero & Climate Resilience priorities. Explicit exclusion rules: Thermal coal underwriting/investment. Official application portal: https://www.zurich.com/sustainability.

chunks.title: Zurich Türkiye Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: Zurich Life & Pension Türkiye (Zurich Group) uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
